evidence: The FY2016 10-K (0000021344-17-000009) tags -320M under 2016's dates, but its own text puts the charge in 2015: "Interest expense during the year ended December 31, 2015 included charges of $320 million the Company recorded on the early extinguishment of certain long-term debt" (Item 7); it names no 2016 extinguishment. The FY2017 10-K (0000021344-18-000008) presents 2016 with none.

The FY2020 10-K (0000021344-21-000008) tags +27M under 2019's dates, but its own text puts the gain in 2018: "the Company recorded a net gain of $27 million in the line item interest expense in our consolidated statement of income during the year ended December 31, 2018" (Note 10). The FY2019 10-K (0000021344-20-000006) tags no 2019 figure and says "prior year interest expense included a net gain of $27 million".
